name: fstat64
description: fstat64 is a variant of fstat that retrieves information about the file referred to by the file descriptor fd, using a 64-bit stat structure for compatibility with larger file systems and attributes.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the file to retrieve status for

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure where the file status information will be stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
fd is not a valid open file descriptor
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
A component of the path prefix is not a directory
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the appropriate types

bugs: Different fields in the stat structure may contain state information from different moments during execution, potentially leading to inconsistencies if the file is modified concurrently.
